title: Momentum Transfer Collision Lab
description: Two cars (CarConcept and Ferrari) sit on a flat track with adjustable mass represented by stacked ShaderBalls loaded onto each vehicle. The user configures mass distributions, launch velocities, and collision elasticity, then simulates collisions while verifying conservation of momentum and kinetic energy. Full undo/redo of every parameter change is supported.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a 1D collision physics lab. Load CarConcept.glb on the left and ferrari.glb on the right, both resting on a flat ground plane track. Load ShaderBall2.glb and clone it to create stackable mass units that sit on top of each car's roof. Camera: perspective at (0,5,14) looking at origin. Lighting: one DirectionalLight with shadows, one HemisphereLight. Ground is a long BoxGeometry with grid texture. UI panel (HTML overlay, top-left): (1) Two sliders to set each car's initial velocity (-10 to 10 m/s). (2) Two +/- button pairs to add or remove ShaderBall masses on each car (1-5 balls each, each ball = 200kg, base car mass = 800kg). Balls stack visually on the car roof. (3) A slider for coefficient of restitution (0 = perfectly inelastic to 1 = perfectly elastic). (4) A Launch button that animates both cars toward center using configured velocities, detects collision via bounding box overlap, then computes post-collision velocities using conservation of momentum and the restitution coefficient. Cars animate to final velocities and slide to rest via friction. (5) A Reset button restoring cars to start positions. (6) Undo and Redo buttons that track every parameter change (velocity, mass add/remove, restitution) in a history stack and restore the full state. (7) A live HUD (bottom) showing each car's current mass, velocity, total system momentum, and total kinetic energy, updated in real time during animation. Verify momentum is conserved post-collision by displaying a green checkmark when |p_before - p_after| < 0.01. During animation, smoothly interpolate car positions using requestAnimationFrame. Add OrbitControls for camera. All interactions must be at least 10 steps: set velocity A, set velocity B, add mass to A twice, add mass to B, adjust restitution, launch, reset, undo twice, redo once.
